newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN DATA DUE - Trade, GDP, CPI.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN DATA DUE - Trade, GDP, CPI.

text.p: The following German economic indicators are expected to be released next week:
Foreign trade Dec, Yr 96 Nov +9.8 bln dm Mar 4
GDP Q4 Q4 -0.2 pct - Buba Mar 5
Numbers in work Dec Nov 34.5 million Mar 6
Wholesale sales Jan Dec -0.2 pct m/m Mar 6-7
NOTE - The Federal Statistics Office said the expected release dates were targets. CPI data to be published are harmonised series for January 1996 to January 1997.
The Federal Labour Office is also due to release February unemployment data on Thursday, March 6 after January unadjusted joblessness hit 4.66 million, a post-war record.
